title: Map tools: a tidy rail on the right
summary: On computers and tablets the map tools now stand in one column on the right instead of a bar across the middle of the map. Phones keep the familiar bottom bar.
items: Tools are grouped: Move, Play, Table and View, with Here and Plan journey now in the same place as everything else.
Tool names show beside the rail the first time; hide them whenever you like, and hover or long-press an icon to see its name and shortcut.
New Layers panel: choose what shows on the map and turn the grid display on or off.
New shortcuts: D draw, J plan a journey, E here, L layers, and I for the DM's encounter controls.
Zoom is now a small pill in the bottom-right corner.
